title: GVRN Incorporation
description: Collect and submit company incorporation requests for review by GVRN's corpsec team.
summary: Collect and submit company incorporation requests for review by GVRN's corpsec team.
offersHint: Collect and submit company incorporation requests for review by GVRN's corpsec team. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://core-api.gvrn.ai/incorporation-mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_incorporation_guide
toolsPreview.description: Returns the full GVRN incorporation workflow guide: the fields collected, the email-verification steps, and the review lifecycle. Also available as the MCP resource gvrn://incorporation/guide.

toolsPreview.name: request_email_otp
toolsPreview.description: Sends a 6-digit verification code to the given email address. The code is exchanged for a verificationToken via verify_email_otp, and that token authorizes the draft tools. Codes expire after 10 minutes and are rate-limited per email.

toolsPreview.name: verify_email_otp
toolsPreview.description: Verifies a 6-digit email code and returns a verificationToken valid for ~30 minutes. The draft tools require this token. Re-verifying the same email issues a fresh token that still reaches the same drafts.

toolsPreview.name: create_incorporation_draft
toolsPreview.description: Creates a new incorporation request draft bound to the verified email, using any fields provided. Requires a verificationToken from verify_email_otp; every other field is optional. Returns a draftId that identifies the draft for later updates, submission, and status checks.

toolsPreview.name: update_incorporation_draft
toolsPreview.description: Adds or corrects fields on an existing draft (patch semantics: only provided fields are changed; array fields are replaced whole). Requires a verificationToken for the email that created the draft. Fails once the draft has been submitted.

toolsPreview.name: submit_incorporation
toolsPreview.description: Submits a draft for review by the GVRN team and returns the request status. Requires a verificationToken for the email that created the draft, which becomes the contact for the request. Optional fields may be left blank. Irreversible: the draft becomes read-only and a review request is filed with the GVRN team.

toolsPreview.name: get_incorporation_status
toolsPreview.description: Returns the current status of an incorporation request (DRAFT → QUEUED_FOR_REVIEW → UNDER_REVIEW → COMPLETED). Requires a verificationToken for the email that created the draft; requests are only visible to that email.
